body.subtitle: Autumn/Winter ’26 Men’s Show
body.description: For AW26, Paul Smith looks to the archive with a fresh perspective. Familiar pieces, colours and patterns are revisited and reimagined through a contemporary lens, bringing new depth to tailoring and considered contrasts of colour, texture and proportion. First unveiled in Milan in January, the collection marks a new chapter for Paul Smith — where the familiar takes on a new perspective.

entity.name: Susan Bijl x Paul Smith - Lilac Mixed-Stripe 'The New Shopping Bag' Medium
entity.short_description_text: Susan Bijl X Paul Smith mixed stripe the new shopping bag, size medium.
entity.product_description_text:
Susan Bijl X Paul Smith mixed stripe the new shopping bag, size medium.

A simple yet iconic design with tremendous volume. It makes any plastic bag irrelevant and replaces all other bags. Created with your daily essentials in mind, anytime, any place. The bag effortlessly folds due to its lightweight and resilient material; therefore a perfect portable bag to take with you.
entity.care_info_text: The best way to remove stains is to treat the stain by hand. This product can also be machine washed at 30 degrees, preferably using a short program. Reserve machine washing for when necessary and avoid extended soaking.
entity.material_information_text: This product is made from waterproof, fluorine-free ripstop nylon with 100% recycled yarn, dyed under Bluesign® certification.

entity.product_description_text:

relatedColors.name: Paul Smith Botanist Diffuser, 250ml
relatedColors.excerpt:
Blended with premium and alcohol-free ingredients, this diffuser is formulated to ensure exceptional scent diffusion. The oil is housed in a tinted glass vessel complete with a contrasting collar, an expression of Paul’s fondness for colour and its endless combinations. When in use, you’ll notice it catches the light beautifully and when finished, it can be reused again and again with fresh reeds or even as a stem vase for flowers.  

Fragrance notes: Lemon, Black Pepper, Vetiver, Moss

relatedColors.features_information_text:
250ml e 8.4 fl oz

Fragrance notes: Lemon, Black Pepper, Vetiver, Moss     

To get the best from your diffuser, there’s a few tips and tricks to keep in mind. Carefully open the bottle containing the liquid and slowly pour its entire contents into the glass vessel. Next, place the collar on top and insert the reeds. You might find that it takes up to 24 hours for the reeds to fully absorb the fragrance. For best scent diffusion, place in a room with good air circulation and try turning the reeds every now and then. Speaking of which, be mindful not to place your diffuser near the edges of surfaces (and keep it away from wagging tails and little ones). When it’s time to reuse the vessel, avoid using the dishwasher. Instead, wash in warm soapy water.

entity.name: Caran d'Ache + Paul Smith - 849 Blue & Green Ballpoint Pen
entity.excerpt:
Now in its fourth edition, our collaboration with the iconic Swiss stationer is a celebration of colour and creativity, as well as Paul’s long-time love of the Caran d’Ache 849 pen.

With a two-tone colour scheme – a graphic nod to Paul’s popular stripe motifs – each combination has been carefully chosen to contrast, clash or coordinate, reflecting Paul’s clever use of colour.

Made in Switzerland with a strong aluminium hexagonal body and a flexible clip, this pen is finished with a Paul Smith signature on the body. 

Presented in a slim, padded case bearing the aforementioned two-tone colour scheme, this pen comes with a black medium Goliath ink cartridge which lasts up to 600 A4 pages.

Now in its fourth edition, our collaboration with the iconic Swiss stationer is a celebration of colour and creativity, as well as Paul’s long-time love of the Caran d’Ache 849 pen.

With a two-tone colour scheme – a graphic nod to Paul’s popular stripe motifs – each combination has been carefully chosen to contrast, clash or coordinate, reflecting Paul’s clever use of colour.

Made in Switzerland with a strong aluminium hexagonal body and a flexible clip, this pen is finished with a Paul Smith signature on the body. 

Presented in a slim, padded case bearing the aforementioned two-tone colour scheme, this pen comes with a black medium Goliath ink cartridge which lasts up to 600 A4 pages.

entity.name: Caran d'Ache + Paul Smith - 849 Red & Pink Ballpoint Pen
entity.excerpt:
Now in its fourth edition, our collaboration with the iconic Swiss stationer is a celebration of colour and creativity, as well as Paul’s long-time love of the Caran d’Ache 849 pen.

With a two-tone colour scheme – a graphic nod to Paul’s popular stripe motifs – each combination has been carefully chosen to contrast, clash or coordinate, reflecting Paul’s clever use of colour.

Made in Switzerland with a strong aluminium hexagonal body and a flexible clip, this pen is finished with a Paul Smith signature on the body. 

Presented in a slim, padded case bearing the aforementioned two-tone colour scheme, this pen comes with a black medium Goliath ink cartridge which lasts up to 600 A4 pages.

With a two-tone colour scheme – a graphic nod to Paul’s popular stripe motifs – each combination has been carefully chosen to contrast, clash or coordinate, reflecting Paul’s clever use of colour.

Made in Switzerland with a strong aluminium hexagonal body and a flexible clip, this pen is finished with a Paul Smith signature on the body. 

Presented in a slim, padded case bearing the aforementioned two-tone colour scheme, this pen comes with a black medium Goliath ink cartridge which lasts up to 600 A4 pages.

Now in its fourth edition, our collaboration with the iconic Swiss stationer is a celebration of colour and creativity, as well as Paul’s long-time love of the Caran d’Ache 849 pen.

With a two-tone colour scheme – a graphic nod to Paul’s popular stripe motifs – each combination has been carefully chosen to contrast, clash or coordinate, reflecting Paul’s clever use of colour.

Made in Switzerland with a strong aluminium hexagonal body and a flexible clip, this pen is finished with a Paul Smith signature on the body. 

Presented in a slim, padded case bearing the aforementioned two-tone colour scheme, this pen comes with a black medium Goliath ink cartridge which lasts up to 600 A4 pages.

relatedColors.meta_title_text: Alessi x Paul Smith - 9093 Stainless Steel Kettle
relatedColors.product_description_text:
This Alessi x Paul Smith kettle features a unique combination of colours which is exclusive to Paul Smith. Paul’s doodles are engraved into the lid of the kettle featuring birds and ‘Paul Smith’ in sky writing.

The 9093 kettle, with bird-shaped whistle is one of the best-selling Alessi objects in the world. The design of this kettle, created by Michael Graves in 1985, mixes the influences taken from European Art, American Pop and quotes from pre-Columbian cultures. Graves's unique visual language is the reason behind the extraordinary success that the kettle has had since the year of its production. It is a smart object, elegant, but at the same time playful and fun: when the water starts boiling, the bird sings, leading to an inevitable smile.

relatedColors.product_description_text:
This Alessi x Paul Smith moka pot features Paul’s handwriting: ‘Every day is a new beginning’ engraved into the lid.

A coffee maker with a familiar and at the same time innovative form. Designed by architect David Chipperfield, Moka is an artist's interpretation of a timeless icon of the Italian culture. Chipperfield introduces a series of details that make the Moka design new and even more functional, such as the flat lid on which to place the cups to be heated - allowing optimum enjoyment of the aroma and flavour of the drink. For those who don't want to compromise on the unmistakeable taste of coffee prepared with an espresso coffee maker.

entity.product_description_text:
This Alessi x Paul Smith kettle features a unique combination of colours which is exclusive to Paul Smith. Paul’s doodles are engraved into the lid of the kettle featuring birds and ‘Paul Smith’ in sky writing.

The 9093 kettle, with bird-shaped whistle is one of the best-selling Alessi objects in the world. The design of this kettle, created by Michael Graves in 1985, mixes the influences taken from European Art, American Pop and quotes from pre-Columbian cultures. Graves's unique visual language is the reason behind the extraordinary success that the kettle has had since the year of its production. It is a smart object, elegant, but at the same time playful and fun: when the water starts boiling, the bird sings, leading to an inevitable smile.

Paul Smith + Kask Utopia helmet with a new navy 'Marble Inks' design.

Aerodynamics is at the forefront of Utopia’s design with ventilation also a key factor considered during its development. Suitable for road racing and triathlon, Utopia can be used year-round in all climates, due to its refined design to keep the rider cool, especially when riding at high speed.

relatedColors.product_description_text:
This Alessi x Paul Smith kettle features a unique combination of colours which is exclusive to Paul Smith. Paul’s doodles are engraved into the lid of the kettle featuring birds and ‘Paul Smith’ in sky writing.

The 9093 kettle, with bird-shaped whistle is one of the best-selling Alessi objects in the world. The design of this kettle, created by Michael Graves in 1985, mixes the influences taken from European Art, American Pop and quotes from pre-Columbian cultures. Graves's unique visual language is the reason behind the extraordinary success that the kettle has had since the year of its production. Set composed of sommelier corkscrew “Parrot - Proust” in cast aluminium and PC hand decorated, “Noè” wine and champagne bottle stopper with expanding seal in 18/10 stainless steel and “Sitges” bottle coaster in 18/10 stainless steel.

Objects for serving wine have always been an area of specialisation for Alessi. The first catalogues published in the 1920s and 1930s already presented a wide variety of products from champagne glasses to coolers, from flask holders to liqueur services. Over the years, the exploration of this world has led to the creation of objects that have become iconic, such as the collection of bar and wine accessories designed by Ettore Sottsass in the 1970s or the Anna G. Corkscrew created by Alessandro Mendini in 1994. The Alessi & Wine set pays tribute to this long design tradition, offering a selection of essential accessories to complement the service of wine.

entity.meta_title_text: Paul Smith Storyteller 3-Wick Scented Candle, 1000g
entity.product_description_text:
A smoky, wintery, and downright cosy scent, our new Storyteller candles and diffusers – the latest additions to Paul Smith’s home fragrance line up – evoke some very special memories for Paul. 

Hand-poured and blended with premium ingredients, this candle is formulated to ensure exceptional scent diffusion. The wax is housed in a tinted glass vessel complete with a contrasting lid that doubles as a coaster, an expression of Paul’s fondness for colour and its endless combinations. Once burned, why not give yours a new life as a pen or plant pot? Or perhaps use it to hold art supplies, toiletries, flowers or any bits and bobs?

relatedColors.product_description_text:
This Alessi x Paul Smith kettle features a unique combination of colours which is exclusive to Paul Smith. Paul’s doodles are engraved into the lid of the kettle featuring birds and ‘Paul Smith’ in sky writing.

The 9093 kettle, with bird-shaped whistle is one of the best-selling Alessi objects in the world. The design of this kettle, created by Michael Graves in 1985, mixes the influences taken from European Art, American Pop and quotes from pre-Columbian cultures. Graves's unique visual language is the reason behind the extraordinary success that the kettle has had since the year of its production. It is a smart object, elegant, but at the same time playful and fun: when the water starts boiling, the bird sings, leading to an inevitable smile.

relatedColors.product_description_text:
This Alessi x Paul Smith moka pot features Paul’s handwriting: ‘Every day is a new beginning’ engraved into the lid.

A coffee maker with a familiar and at the same time innovative form. Designed by architect David Chipperfield, Moka is an artist's interpretation of a timeless icon of the Italian culture. Chipperfield introduces a series of details that make the Moka design new and even more functional, such as the flat lid on which to place the cups to be heated - allowing optimum enjoyment of the aroma and flavour of the drink. For those who don't want to compromise on the unmistakeable taste of coffee prepared with an espresso coffee maker.

gomi tag is a super-easy, sustainable way to keep track of what matters.

It uses Bluetooth technology and the Apple 'Find My' App to securely report its location straight to your iPhone or iPad.

relatedColors.features_information_text:
[b]Dimensions[/b]
200mm (W) x 95mm (H) x 70mm (D)
[b]Sound quality[/b]
3” full range neodymium driver (7.6cm) with 3” (7.6cm) bass radiator
[b]Weight[/b]
1.04kg
[b]Battery life[/b]
32 hours at normal listening volume
[b]Connectivity[/b]
Bluetooth 5.0, 3.5mm AUX input, TWS pairing with another gomi collection one speaker 
[b]Wireless[/b]
Up to 10 metre range
[b]Power input[/b]
USB-C (Rated Capacity: 44.4 Wh, 5V/2A, 9V/2A, 15V/2A, 20V/1.5A)
[b]Power output[/b]
25W 
[b]Frequency response[/b]
(-)10dB points 75Hz - 20kHz 
[b]Impedance[/b]
8Ω 
[b]Safety certificiations[/b]
UKCA, CE, ROHS, REACH
[b]Emissions in manufacturing[/b]
9.06kg (50.4% less than a market leading equivalent Bluetooth speaker of same size and weight)
[b]Included in the box[/b]
gomi speaker, 2 metre USB-C to USB-C charging cable*, manual,
*USB-C power delivery wall plug not included 

[b]gomi[/b]

gomi was created with a clear sense of purpose - to make beautiful products that last.
Their design philosophy is that tech shouldn’t become obsolete. Instead, we design for circular lifespans. Waste plastics and second-life batteries form the building blocks. Modular design allows gomi to fix what might otherwise have been thrown away.

Casing made from 100% ‘non-recyclable’ plastics sourced from waste flows around the UK, gomi is designed to last. 

Splash Resistant, IPX6-rated water resistance, completely sealed from water-spray from all directions. Perfect for beach, shower, swimming pool and splashy water environments.

This Alessi x Paul Smith kettle features a unique combination of colours which is exclusive to Paul Smith. Paul’s doodles are engraved into the lid of the kettle featuring birds and ‘Paul Smith’ in sky writing.

The 9093 kettle, with bird-shaped whistle is one of the best-selling Alessi objects in the world. The design of this kettle, created by Michael Graves in 1985, mixes the influences taken from European Art, American Pop and quotes from pre-Columbian cultures. It is a smart object, elegant, but at the same time playful and fun: when the water starts boiling, the bird sings, leading to an inevitable smile.

Set composed of sommelier corkscrew “Parrot - Proust” in cast aluminium and PC hand decorated, “Noè” wine and champagne bottle stopper with expanding seal in 18/10 stainless steel and “Sitges” bottle coaster in 18/10 stainless steel.

Objects for serving wine have always been an area of specialisation for Alessi. The first catalogues published in the 1920s and 1930s already presented a wide variety of products from champagne glasses to coolers, from flask holders to liqueur services. Over the years, the exploration of this world has led to the creation of objects that have become iconic, such as the collection of bar and wine accessories designed by Ettore Sottsass in the 1970s or the Anna G. Corkscrew created by Alessandro Mendini in 1994. The Alessi & Wine set pays tribute to this long design tradition, offering a selection of essential accessories to complement the service of wine.

A coffee maker with a familiar and at the same time innovative form. Designed by architect David Chipperfield, Moka is an artist's interpretation of a timeless icon of the Italian culture. entity.meta_description_text: Made in Switzerland with a brass body with a platinum finish, this pen features a hexagonal shape with milled 'Shadow Stripe' guilloché pattern.
entity.meta_title_text: Caran d'Ache + Paul Smith - Ecridor Silver Ball Point Pen and Leather Pouch Set
entity.product_description_text:
For over ten years, Caran d’Ache and Paul Smith have celebrated their shared passion for colour, design and audacity. With this 5th edition, the Swiss Maison and the British designer playfully push boundaries to reinvent the art of the beautifully crafted object.

Made in Switzerland with a brass body with a platinum finish, this pen features a hexagonal shape with milled 'Shadow Stripe' guilloché pattern. ‘Paul Smith’ and ‘Write it down’ signatures, originally handwritten by Paul Smith are engraved in guilloché using a milling cutter.

Complete with a smooth black cowhide leather pouch with ‘Shadow Stripe’ emboss with an intuitive opening inspired by eyewear cases.

Presented in a raw silver-effect metal case with a black Caran d’Ache + Paul Smith logo on the outside.

relatedColors.features_information_text:
250ml e 8.4 fl oz

Fragrance notes: Lemon, Black Pepper, Vetiver, Moss     

To get the best from your diffuser, there’s a few tips and tricks to keep in mind. Carefully open the bottle containing the liquid and slowly pour its entire contents into the glass vessel. Next, place the collar on top and insert the reeds. You might find that it takes up to 24 hours for the reeds to fully absorb the fragrance. For best scent diffusion, place in a room with good air circulation and try turning the reeds every now and then. Speaking of which, be mindful not to place your diffuser near the edges of surfaces (and keep it away from wagging tails and little ones). When it’s time to reuse the vessel, avoid using the dishwasher. Instead, wash in warm soapy water.

The 9093 kettle, with bird-shaped whistle is one of the best-selling Alessi objects in the world. The design of this kettle, created by Michael Graves in 1985, mixes the influences taken from European Art, American Pop and quotes from pre-Columbian cultures. Objects for serving wine have always been an area of specialisation for Alessi. The first catalogues published in the 1920s and 1930s already presented a wide variety of products from champagne glasses to coolers, from flask holders to liqueur services. Over the years, the exploration of this world has led to the creation of objects that have become iconic, such as the collection of bar and wine accessories designed by Ettore Sottsass in the 1970s or the Anna G. relatedColors.product_description_text:
This Alessi x Paul Smith moka pot features Paul’s handwriting: ‘Every day is a new beginning’ engraved into the lid.

A coffee maker with a familiar and at the same time innovative form. Designed by architect David Chipperfield, Moka is an artist's interpretation of a timeless icon of the Italian culture. Chipperfield introduces a series of details that make the Moka design new and even more functional, such as the flat lid on which to place the cups to be heated - allowing optimum enjoyment of the aroma and flavour of the drink. For those who don't want to compromise on the unmistakeable taste of coffee prepared with an espresso coffee maker.

entity.name: Paul Smith Daydreamer 3-Wick Scented Candle, 1000g
entity.excerpt:
Hand-poured and blended with premium ingredients, this candle is formulated to ensure exceptional scent diffusion in large rooms. The wax is housed in a tinted glass vessel complete with a contrasting lid that doubles as a coaster, an expression of Paul’s fondness for colour and its endless combinations. When lit, you’ll notice it catches the light beautifully and once burned, it can be reused again and again. Why not give yours a new life as a pen or plant pot? Or perhaps use it to hold art supplies, toiletries, flowers or any bits and bobs?

Fragrance notes: Verbena, Clary Sage, Lavender, Hay.

entity.name: Sunseeker 3-Wick Scented Candle, 1000g
entity.excerpt:
The latest addition to the Paul Smith Home Collection's home fragrance line, new for Spring Summer 2023, Sunseeker and is a summery scent that’ll have you dreaming of Italy. 

The wax is housed in a tinted glass vessel complete with a contrasting lid that doubles as a coaster, an expression of Paul’s fondness for colour and its endless combinations. When lit, you’ll notice it catches the light beautifully and once burned, it can be reused again and again. Why not give yours a new life as a pen or plant pot? Or perhaps use it to hold art supplies, toiletries, flowers or any bits and bobs?

relatedColors.name: Paul Smith Sunseeker Diffuser, 250ml
relatedColors.excerpt:
The latest addition to the Paul Smith Home Collection's home fragrance line, new for Spring Summer 2023, Sunseeker and is a summery scent that’ll have you dreaming of Italy.

Blended with premium and alcohol-free ingredients, this diffuser is formulated to ensure exceptional scent diffusion. The oil is housed in a tinted glass vessel complete with a contrasting collar, an expression of Paul’s fondness for colour and its endless combinations. When in use, you’ll notice it catches the light beautifully and when finished, it can be reused again and again with fresh reeds or even as a stem vase for flowers.

relatedColors.features_information_text:
Fragrance notes: Italian bergamot, mandarin, and basil.

250ml e 8.4 fl oz

To get the best from your diffuser, there’s a few tips and tricks to keep in mind. Carefully open the bottle containing the liquid and slowly pour its entire contents into the glass vessel. Next, place the collar on top and insert the reeds. You might find that it takes up to 24 hours for the reeds to fully absorb the fragrance. For best scent diffusion, place in a room with good air circulation and try turning the reeds every now and then. Speaking of which, be mindful not to place your diffuser near the edges of surfaces (and keep it away from wagging tails and little ones). When it’s time to reuse the vessel, avoid using the dishwasher. Instead, wash in warm soapy water.

relatedColors.features_information_text:
250ml e 8.4 fl oz

Fragrance notes: Rain, Iris, Suede, Patchouli 

To get the best from your diffuser, there’s a few tips and tricks to keep in mind. Carefully open the bottle containing the liquid and slowly pour its entire contents into the glass vessel. Next, place the collar on top and insert the reeds. You might find that it takes up to 24 hours for the reeds to fully absorb the fragrance. For best scent diffusion, place in a room with good air circulation and try turning the reeds every now and then. Speaking of which, be mindful not to place your diffuser near the edges of surfaces (and keep it away from wagging tails and little ones). When it’s time to reuse the vessel, avoid using the dishwasher. Instead, wash in warm soapy water.

entity.features_information_text:
- 240g e 8.4oz
- Height: 12cm / 4.7in
- Diameter: 8cm / 3.1in
- Fragrance notes: Green stem, lily, freesia, patchouli.
- Burn time: 60 hours 

CAUTION: Only burn this candle on a level, heat resistant surface. Do not burn for more than 4 hours at a time. Keep wick trimmed to 5mm. Stop using when 10mm of wax remains or wick disk becomes visible. Allow wax to harden before moving. Take care when extinguishing the flame. Keep candles 10cm apart and allow headroom for flame.
entity.meta_description_text: Paul Smith Leaf Scented Candle, 240g with notes of green stem, lily, freesia, patchouli.
entity.meta_title_text: Paul Smith Leaf Scented Candle, 240g
entity.product_description_text:
Conjuring the lush, green atmosphere of a florist’s shop, Leaf is composed of cut flower stems, freesia, lily, and patchouli. Its bright, fresh character echoes one of Paul’s favourite sayings: every day is a new beginning.

Hand-poured and blended with premium ingredients, this candle is formulated to ensure exceptional scent diffusion. The wax is housed in a tinted glass vessel complete with a contrasting lid that doubles as a coaster, an expression of Paul’s fondness for colour and its endless combinations. When lit, you’ll notice it catches the light beautifully and once burned, it can be reused again and again. Why not give yours a new life as a pen or plant pot? Or perhaps use it to hold art supplies, toiletries, flowers or any bits and bobs?

products.name: Caran d'Ache + Paul Smith - 849 Blue & Green Ballpoint Pen
products.excerpt:
Now in its fourth edition, our collaboration with the iconic Swiss stationer is a celebration of colour and creativity, as well as Paul’s long-time love of the Caran d’Ache 849 pen.

With a two-tone colour scheme – a graphic nod to Paul’s popular stripe motifs – each combination has been carefully chosen to contrast, clash or coordinate, reflecting Paul’s clever use of colour.

Made in Switzerland with a strong aluminium hexagonal body and a flexible clip, this pen is finished with a Paul Smith signature on the body. 

Presented in a slim, padded case bearing the aforementioned two-tone colour scheme, this pen comes with a black medium Goliath ink cartridge which lasts up to 600 A4 pages.

To get the best from your diffuser, there’s a few tips and tricks to keep in mind. Carefully open the bottle containing the liquid and slowly pour its entire contents into the glass vessel. Next, place the collar on top and insert the reeds. You might find that it takes up to 24 hours for the reeds to fully absorb the fragrance. The wax is housed in a tinted glass vessel complete with a contrasting lid that doubles as a coaster, an expression of Paul’s fondness for colour and its endless combinations. Once burned, why not give yours a new life as a pen or plant pot? Or perhaps use it to hold art supplies, toiletries, flowers or any bits and bobs?

gift_budget_quiz: I'd like to spoil them (within reason)
relatedColors.features_information_text:
- 240g e 8.4oz
- Height: 12cm / 4.7in
- Diameter: 8cm / 3.1in
- Fragrance notes: Green stem, lily, freesia, patchouli.
- Burn time: 60 hours 

CAUTION: Only burn this candle on a level, heat resistant surface. Do not burn for more than 4 hours at a time. Keep wick trimmed to 5mm. Stop using when 10mm of wax remains or wick disk becomes visible. Allow wax to harden before moving. Take care when extinguishing the flame. Keep candles 10cm apart and allow headroom for flame.
relatedColors.meta_description_text: Paul Smith Leaf Scented Candle, 240g with notes of green stem, lily, freesia, patchouli.
relatedColors.product_description_text:
Conjuring the lush, green atmosphere of a florist’s shop, Leaf is composed of cut flower stems, freesia, lily, and patchouli. Its bright, fresh character echoes one of Paul’s favourite sayings: every day is a new beginning.

Hand-poured and blended with premium ingredients, this candle is formulated to ensure exceptional scent diffusion. The wax is housed in a tinted glass vessel complete with a contrasting lid that doubles as a coaster, an expression of Paul’s fondness for colour and its endless combinations. When lit, you’ll notice it catches the light beautifully and once burned, it can be reused again and again. Why not give yours a new life as a pen or plant pot? Or perhaps use it to hold art supplies, toiletries, flowers or any bits and bobs?

entity.name: Paul Smith + Kask 'Ombre Green' Utopia Cycling Helmet
entity.excerpt:
Building upon their strong and ever-popular long term partnership, Paul Smith + Kask have collaborated once again and produced the new for Autumn/Winter 23 'Ombre' collection.

Aerodynamics is at the forefront of Utopia’s design with ventilation also a key factor considered during its development. Suitable for road racing and triathlon, Utopia can be used year-round in all climates, due to its refined design to keep the rider cool, especially when riding at high speed.

Utopia uses a breathable and quick-dry padding, offering a 5mm layer of fast-wicking material called Resistex®* that takes moisture away from the rider’s head and moves it to the helmet’s outer shell, contributing to a helmet that’s comfortable to wear all day.

250ml e 8.4 fl oz

Fragrance notes: Rain, Iris, Suede, Patchouli 

To get the best from your diffuser, there’s a few tips and tricks to keep in mind. Carefully open the bottle containing the liquid and slowly pour its entire contents into the glass vessel. Next, place the collar on top and insert the reeds. You might find that it takes up to 24 hours for the reeds to fully absorb the fragrance. For best scent diffusion, place in a room with good air circulation and try turning the reeds every now and then. Speaking of which, be mindful not to place your diffuser near the edges of surfaces (and keep it away from wagging tails and little ones). When it’s time to reuse the vessel, avoid using the dishwasher. Instead, wash in warm soapy water.

relatedColors.excerpt:
The latest addition to the Paul Smith Home Collection's home fragrance line, new for Spring Summer 2023, Sunseeker and is a summery scent that’ll have you dreaming of Italy.

250ml e 8.4 fl oz

To get the best from your diffuser, there’s a few tips and tricks to keep in mind. Carefully open the bottle containing the liquid and slowly pour its entire contents into the glass vessel. Next, place the collar on top and insert the reeds. You might find that it takes up to 24 hours for the reeds to fully absorb the fragrance. For best scent diffusion, place in a room with good air circulation and try turning the reeds every now and then. Speaking of which, be mindful not to place your diffuser near the edges of surfaces (and keep it away from wagging tails and little ones). When it’s time to reuse the vessel, avoid using the dishwasher. Instead, wash in warm soapy water.

relatedColors.excerptHtml:
Blended with premium and alcohol-free ingredients, this diffuser is formulated to ensure exceptional scent diffusion. The oil is housed in a tinted glass vessel complete with a contrasting collar, an expression of Paul’s fondness for colour and its endless combinations. relatedColors.features_information_text:
250ml e 8.4 fl oz

Fragrance notes: Lemon, Black Pepper, Vetiver, Moss     

To get the best from your diffuser, there’s a few tips and tricks to keep in mind. Carefully open the bottle containing the liquid and slowly pour its entire contents into the glass vessel. Next, place the collar on top and insert the reeds. You might find that it takes up to 24 hours for the reeds to fully absorb the fragrance. For best scent diffusion, place in a room with good air circulation and try turning the reeds every now and then. Speaking of which, be mindful not to place your diffuser near the edges of surfaces (and keep it away from wagging tails and little ones). When it’s time to reuse the vessel, avoid using the dishwasher. Instead, wash in warm soapy water.

To get the best from your diffuser, there’s a few tips and tricks to keep in mind. Carefully open the bottle containing the liquid and slowly pour its entire contents into the glass vessel. Next, place the collar on top and insert the reeds. You might find that it takes up to 24 hours for the reeds to fully absorb the fragrance. For best scent diffusion, place in a room with good air circulation and try turning the reeds every now and then. Speaking of which, be mindful not to place your diffuser near the edges of surfaces (and keep it away from wagging tails and little ones). When it’s time to reuse the vessel, avoid using the dishwasher. Instead, wash in warm soapy water.

entity.product_description_text:

entity.meta_title_text: Ratio by Paul Smith x The Rug Company - Axis Lake Rug
entity.product_description_text:
In the latest chapter of their enduring creative partnership, The Rug Company unveils Ratio by Paul Smith, a collection that translates the designer’s distinctive approach to pattern into richly tactile form. A longstanding admirer of modernist design, Paul Smith brings his characteristic balance of discipline and expressiveness to the collection, with The Rug Company's artisanal expertise adding a helping hand.

entity.product_description_text:
In the latest chapter of their enduring creative partnership, The Rug Company unveils Ratio by Paul Smith, a collection that translates the designer’s distinctive approach to pattern into richly tactile form. A longstanding admirer of modernist design, Paul Smith brings his characteristic balance of discipline and expressiveness to the collection, with The Rug Company's artisanal expertise adding a helping hand. 

Ratio comprises of four designs—Axis, Stil, Raster and Takt—all in different formats, each offering a distinct interpretation of geometric order. 

[b]Raster Aegean[/b] softens its graphic design through texture. Bold blocks and stripes in tonal blue hues sit against a richly tactile ground, creating a quiet interplay between pattern and surface. Handknotted in New Zealand wool using the Tulu technique, rows of cut pile and flatweave bring depth and movement to the Bauhaus-inspired design.

[b]Size shown in imagery does not always represent the size available to buy online. If you require a larger size, please contact customer services directly.[/b]

entity.product_description_text:
To Belong Somewhere by David Remfry (2017-2024)

[b]David Remfry[/b]

Born in Worthing in 1942, David Remfry studied at Hull College of Art (1959-64) before establishing himself as a full- time artist in London. Renowned for his large-scale watercolours of dancers and urban life, he captures the energy of nightlife- from Hull's Locarno dancehall in his student years to New York City clubs during his long residency at the Hotel Chelsea from 1995 to 2016. Where the Light Falls brings together key strands of Remfry's work, including his watercolours of dancers alongaide more recent oil paintings.

Remfry' was elected to the Royal Academy of Arts in 2006 where he served as Professor of Drawing at the RA Schools from 2016-18, and in 2023, he coordinated the Royal Academy's Summer Exhibition.

This exhibition coincides with the release of a Monograph David Remfry published by Lund Humphries with essays by Chloe Aridjis, Hettie Judah, Rosalind McKever, Gerardine Mulcahy-Parker and Kathleen Soriano.

The exhibition has been curated by art historian and writer, Jo Baring.

entity.product_description_text:
Untitled, 2001 by David Remfry

[b]David Remfry[/b]

Born in Worthing in 1942, David Remfry studied at Hull College of Art (1959-64) before establishing himself as a full- time artist in London. Renowned for his large-scale watercolours of dancers and urban life, he captures the energy of nightlife- from Hull's Locarno dancehall in his student years to New York City clubs during his long residency at the Hotel Chelsea from 1995 to 2016. Where the Light Falls brings together key strands of Remfry's work, including his watercolours of dancers alongaide more recent oil paintings.

Remfry' was elected to the Royal Academy of Arts in 2006 where he served as Professor of Drawing at the RA Schools from 2016-18, and in 2023, he coordinated the Royal Academy's Summer Exhibition.

This exhibition coincides with the release of a Monograph David Remfry published by Lund Humphries with essays by Chloe Aridjis, Hettie Judah, Rosalind McKever, Gerardine Mulcahy-Parker and Kathleen Soriano.

The exhibition has been curated by art historian and writer, Jo Baring.

entity.product_description_text:
Saudade by Abe Odedina 

[b]Abe Odedina[/b]

Born 1960 in Ibadan, Nigeria, Abe Odedina describes himself as a folk artist- yet, implicitly and explicitly, Odedina's practice questions the validity of 'folk art' as a discrete category. Odedina's work offers objects which embrace their objecthood: a gesture both radical and very simple indeed.

Painting on board rather than canvas, Odedina's compositions embody all the solidity- and practicality- of shop fronts or municipal murals. Compositional elements of Renaissance portraiture, devotional painting and even pop art frame figures from diverse mythologies (Yoruba, Haitian, Ancient Greek) as well as passers-by or characters plucked from the artist's own imagination.

Part of the Drawn Together exhibition

[b]Rita Barros[/b]

Rita Barros was born in Lisbon and has lived in New York since 1980. She has an MA in Art in Media: Studio Art from New York University where she teaches photography. She is the author of the book 'Fifteen Years: Chelsea Hotel', Camara Municipal de Lisboa, 1999. In 2023 her work was the subject of a retrospective edition published by the prestigious Ph collection on the history of Portuguese Contemporary Photographers published by Impresensa Nacional in Portugal.

Her Archive of portraits of writers, musicians and artists (represented by Getty Images) is published regularly in the international press.

Part of the Drawn Together exhibition

entity.meta_title_text: Paul Smith for The Rug Company - Prisma Round Rug
entity.product_description_text:
Paul Smith has returned to collaborate with The Rug Company on a collection of seven new rugs, the designs experiment with familiar forms to create abstract motifs that inform the shape of the rugs. This collection encapsulates the evolution of a historic creative partnership while offering a new perspective on the relationship between color and shape.

Prisma plays with the Signature stripe, using a palette of both muted and deep hues that form around a rose-pink centre and gradually expand to the border. Comprised of 22 individual colours, each shade enriches the handknotted Tibetan wool with playful pigments. 

Available in a rectangular and round design, the latter experiments with a circular form to capture the effect of reverberation.

relatedColors.meta_title_text: Paul Smith for The Rug Company - Spectra Runner Rug - Large
relatedColors.product_description_text:
Paul Smith has returned to collaborate with The Rug Company on a collection of seven new rugs, the designs experiment with familiar forms to create abstract motifs that inform the shape of the rugs. This collection encapsulates the evolution of a historic creative partnership while offering a new perspective on the relationship between colour and shape.

Spectra offers a sophisticated and subtle alternative to the colourful characteristic of the original stripe design. Rectangular blocks of colour use a spectrum of shades that are synonymous with the Paul Smith brand and shift across the surface in a regimented form. 

Each colour is handknotted in a lustrous silk thread that appears elevated against the rich density of the neutral wool base. This design complements transitional spaces, encouraging movement whilst enhancing surroundings with its contemporary take on colourful design.

products.name: Paul Smith Botanist Scented Candle, 240g
products.excerpt:
Hand-poured and blended with premium ingredients, this candle is formulated to ensure exceptional scent diffusion. The wax is housed in a tinted glass vessel complete with a contrasting lid that doubles as a coaster, an expression of Paul’s fondness for colour and its endless combinations. Once burned, why not give yours a new life as a pen or plant pot? Or perhaps use it to hold art supplies, toiletries, flowers or any bits and bobs?

Fragrance notes: Lemon, Black Pepper, Vetiver, Moss.

body.title: The Dream Factory - Look and See
body.description: The Dream Factory capsule brings that spirit to life, taking inspiration from the creative energy of Paul’s office: a place where ideas are born, unexpected details spark new thoughts, and the everyday becomes extraordinary. From sketches and scribbles to objects, colours and curious little discoveries, the collection captures the wonderfully unpredictable world that surrounds Paul as he creates. It’s a celebration of imagination, where inspiration doesn’t follow a formula — it simply appears when you stop, look and see.

body.subtitle: Autumn/Winter ’26 Men’s Show
body.description: For AW26, Paul Smith looks to the archive with a fresh perspective. Familiar pieces, colours and patterns are revisited and reimagined through a contemporary lens, bringing new depth to tailoring and considered contrasts of colour, texture and proportion. First unveiled in Milan in January, the collection marks a new chapter for Paul Smith — where the familiar takes on a new perspective.

Familiar pieces, colours and patterns are revisited and reimagined through a contemporary lens, bringing new depth to tailoring and considered contrasts of colour, texture and proportion. body.subtitle: Behind the Collection
body.description: Rooted in Barbour’s Scottish heritage and Paul Smith’s playful spirit, this is a collaboration with a distinctly British joy and charm, from Authentic Barbour Tartans to Paul Smith’s signature pops of colour and character. While a day out in the highlands may bring unexpected surprises, these are enduring styles full of the practicality – and personality – needed to match any moment.

relatedColors.meta_title_text: Paul Smith loves Barbour - Rust Chelsea Wellingtons
relatedColors.product_description_text: This modern take on the classic Chelsea boot features durable rubber construction, perfect for tackling muddy walks or rainy city streets. But what truly sets these boots apart is the attention to detail that both brands are known for. The vulcanised rubber ensures long-lasting performance, while the signature rubber co-branding on the front gives a nod to this exciting collaboration. Of course, they wouldn’t be Paul Smith without that iconic pop of colour. The back pull loop is dressed in Paul Smith’s signature multi-coloured stripe, ensuring this design is the perfect balance of fun and functionality - made for those who like their style with a bit of personality.

body.title: Paul Smith loves Barbour: The Story
body.subtitle: Behind the Collection
body.description: Rooted in Barbour’s Scottish heritage and Paul Smith’s playful spirit, this is a collaboration with a distinctly British joy and charm, from Authentic Barbour Tartans to Paul Smith’s signature pops of colour and character. While a day out in the highlands may bring unexpected surprises, these are enduring styles full of the practicality – and personality – needed to match any moment.

entity.material_information_text: 100% Leather Uppers, Leather and Rubber soles
entity.meta_description_text: Paul Smith + Grenson have teamed up to offer a capsule of timeless classic footwear.
entity.meta_title_text: Paul Smith + Grenson - Brown 'Coleman' Boots
entity.product_description_text: Paul Smith + Grenson have teamed up to offer a capsule of timeless classic footwear with each pair being made in Northampton by Grenson, in their original factory that has been in operation since 1866. The 'Coleman' is a straight-cap Derby boot made from brown scotch grain leather, featuring Grenson's Triple Welt construction: a unique stepped, triple style welt that makes the most of classic British Goodyear welted shoemaking. Finished with rubber and leather soles for added grip, punctuated with pops of blue, a signature of Paul Smith design.

relatedColors.meta_description_text: Paul Smith + Grenson have teamed up to offer a capsule of timeless classic footwear.
relatedColors.product_description_text: Paul Smith + Grenson have teamed up to offer a capsule of timeless classic footwear with each pair being made in Northampton by Grenson, in their original factory that has been in operation since 1866. The 'Coleman' is a straight-cap Derby boot made from naturally grained black French bison leather, with a soft black Nappa bellows tongue and natural calf lining, featuring Grenson's Triple Welt construction: a unique stepped, triple style welt that makes the most of classic British Goodyear welted shoemaking. Finished with rubber and leather soles for added grip, punctuated with pops of blue, a signature of Paul Smith design.

entity.name: Paul Smith + Grenson - Black 'Coleman' Boots
entity.material_information_text: 100% Leather Uppers, Leather and Rubber soles
entity.meta_description_text: Paul Smith + Grenson have teamed up to offer a capsule of timeless classic footwear.
entity.meta_title_text: Paul Smith + Grenson - Black 'Coleman' Boots
entity.product_description_text: Paul Smith + Grenson have teamed up to offer a capsule of timeless classic footwear with each pair being made in Northampton by Grenson, in their original factory that has been in operation since 1866. The 'Coleman' is a straight-cap Derby boot made from naturally grained black French bison leather, with a soft black Nappa bellows tongue and natural calf lining, featuring Grenson's Triple Welt construction: a unique stepped, triple style welt that makes the most of classic British Goodyear welted shoemaking. Finished with rubber and leather soles for added grip, punctuated with pops of blue, a signature of Paul Smith design.

body.title: A glimpse inside Paul’s world.
body.description: The walls of Paul Smith’s London studio are densely packed with art, objects and ephemera from Paul’s personal collection. Photographs of iconic musicians sit alongside archival design sketches, handwritten notes, paintings, curiosities and fragments of inspiration gathered over the years. This varied mix reflects Paul’s instinct for collecting the unexpected. At the centre of the print is a racing bike from the Paul Smith + Factor collaboration, bringing together engineering, design and Paul’s distinctive eye for detail. The print captures the eclectic spirit of Paul’s studio — a place where art, design, memories and unexpected discoveries come together.

body.title: A glimpse inside Paul’s world.
body.description: The walls of Paul Smith’s London studio are densely packed with art, objects and ephemera from Paul’s personal collection. Photographs of iconic musicians sit alongside archival design sketches, handwritten notes, paintings, curiosities and fragments of inspiration gathered over the years. This varied mix reflects Paul’s instinct for collecting the unexpected. At the centre of the print is a racing bike from the Paul Smith + Factor collaboration, bringing together engineering, design and Paul’s distinctive eye for detail. The print captures the eclectic spirit of Paul’s studio — a place where art, design, memories and unexpected discoveries come together.

body.title: Meet Douglas — a curious wooden creature with his head in the clouds.
body.description: Created by east London design studio Studiomama, he’s part of their playful Off-Cuts collection, a cast of characterful wooden creatures made from scrap wood left behind in their workshop. Douglas is, naturally, the resident daydreamer. Made by layering, dyeing and shaping wood, Douglas celebrates the beauty of handmade craft and the character of leftover materials. A passionate collector with a love of handmade objects, Paul Smith took a particular shine to the Off-Cuts and their playful, inventive spirit. Now, Douglas makes the leap from wooden workshop character to graphic motif, appearing on this pocket square in the new capsule collection.

bloks.description: Created by east London design studio Studiomama, he’s part of their playful Off-Cuts collection, a cast of characterful wooden creatures made from scrap wood left behind in their workshop. Douglas is, naturally, the resident daydreamer. Made by layering, dyeing and shaping wood, Douglas celebrates the beauty of handmade craft and the character of leftover materials. A passionate collector with a love of handmade objects, Paul Smith took a particular shine to the Off-Cuts and their playful, inventive spirit. Now, Douglas makes the leap from wooden workshop character to graphic motif, appearing on this pocket square in the new capsule collection.

body.title: A glimpse inside Paul’s world.
body.description: The walls of Paul Smith’s London studio are densely packed with art, objects and ephemera from Paul’s personal collection. Photographs of iconic musicians sit alongside archival design sketches, handwritten notes, paintings, curiosities and fragments of inspiration gathered over the years. This varied mix reflects Paul’s instinct for collecting the unexpected. At the centre of the print is a racing bike from the Paul Smith + Factor collaboration, bringing together engineering, design and Paul’s distinctive eye for detail. The print captures the eclectic spirit of Paul’s studio — a place where art, design, memories and unexpected discoveries come together.

body.title: A glimpse inside Paul’s world.
body.description: The walls of Paul Smith’s London studio are densely packed with art, objects and ephemera from Paul’s personal collection. Photographs of iconic musicians sit alongside archival design sketches, handwritten notes, paintings, curiosities and fragments of inspiration gathered over the years. This varied mix reflects Paul’s instinct for collecting the unexpected. At the centre of the print is a racing bike from the Paul Smith + Factor collaboration, bringing together engineering, design and Paul’s distinctive eye for detail. The print captures the eclectic spirit of Paul’s studio — a place where art, design, memories and unexpected discoveries come together.

body.title: The Dream Factory - Look and See
body.description: The Dream Factory capsule brings that spirit to life, taking inspiration from the creative energy of Paul’s office: a place where ideas are born, unexpected details spark new thoughts, and the everyday becomes extraordinary. From sketches and scribbles to objects, colours and curious little discoveries, the collection captures the wonderfully unpredictable world that surrounds Paul as he creates. It’s a celebration of imagination, where inspiration doesn’t follow a formula — it simply appears when you stop, look and see.

body.title: From the Studio
body.description: The stack of cycling-jersey totes references an instant-print photograph taken in Paul’s studio, capturing a collection of his colourful cycling tops folded and piled together. Paul’s long-standing connection to cycling is woven into the design, alongside typography inspired by a vintage Paul Smith shirt and an invitation from the 1990s. Together, these unexpected references bring the spirit of Paul’s studio and the Dream Factory capsule to life, where everyday objects, memories and ideas are constantly transformed into something new.

body.description: The Dream Factory capsule brings that spirit to life, taking inspiration from the creative energy of Paul’s office: a place where ideas are born, unexpected details spark new thoughts, and the everyday becomes extraordinary. From sketches and scribbles to objects, colours and curious little discoveries, the collection captures the wonderfully unpredictable world that surrounds Paul as he creates. It’s a celebration of imagination, where inspiration doesn’t follow a formula — it simply appears when you stop, look and see.

body.title: The Soho - Slim-Fit
body.description: The Soho is a classic for a reason. Our bestselling suit, it combines a clean, slim silhouette with a relaxed, natural feel. The half-canvas construction gives the jacket just the right amount of structure, while the slim lapel and slim-leg trousers keep things refined and modern. Smart enough for the big occasions, easy enough for everything in between, the Soho is made to move with you — wherever the day (or night) takes you.

entity.meta_title_text: Paul Smith loves Barbour - Women's Navy Cord Beaufort Jacket
entity.product_description_text:
The corduroy Beaufort jacket offers a fresh interpretation of a Barbour icon, blending the relaxed sophistication of corduroy with Paul Smith’s signature eye for detail. Inspired by the timeless Beaufort silhouette, this elevated design features a contrast-colour throat tab, handwarmer pockets, and the jacket’s signature lower bellows pockets, balancing heritage functionality with contemporary style.

Subtle stripe tape detailing introduces a distinctive Paul Smith touch, while the interior is lined with a combination of Classic and Muted tartans, creating a refined contrast that speaks to the craftsmanship behind the collaboration. Rich in texture and character, this standout piece reimagines British outerwear through a modern, creative lens.

entity.meta_title_text: Paul Smith loves Barbour - Women's Rust Chelsea Wellingtons
entity.product_description_text: This modern take on the classic Chelsea boot features durable rubber construction, perfect for tackling muddy walks or rainy city streets. But what truly sets these boots apart is the attention to detail that both brands are known for. The vulcanised rubber ensures long-lasting performance, while the signature rubber co-branding on the front gives a nod to this exciting collaboration. Of course, they wouldn’t be Paul Smith without that iconic pop of colour. The back pull loop is dressed in Paul Smith’s signature multi-coloured stripe, ensuring this design is the perfect balance of fun and functionality - made for those who like their style with a bit of personality.

body.title: Paul Smith loves Barbour: The Story
body.subtitle: Behind the Collection
body.description: Rooted in Barbour’s Scottish heritage and Paul Smith’s playful spirit, this is a collaboration with a distinctly British joy and charm, from Authentic Barbour Tartans to Paul Smith’s signature pops of colour and character. While a day out in the highlands may bring unexpected surprises, these are enduring styles full of the practicality – and personality – needed to match any moment.

entity.product_description_text: This modern take on the classic Chelsea boot features durable rubber construction, perfect for tackling muddy walks or rainy city streets. But what truly sets these boots apart is the attention to detail that both brands are known for. The vulcanised rubber ensures long-lasting performance, while the signature rubber co-branding on the front gives a nod to this exciting collaboration. Of course, they wouldn’t be Paul Smith without that iconic pop of colour. The back pull loop is dressed in Paul Smith’s signature multi-coloured stripe, ensuring this design is the perfect balance of fun and functionality - made for those who like their style with a bit of personality.

body.subtitle: Behind the Collection
body.description: Rooted in Barbour’s Scottish heritage and Paul Smith’s playful spirit, this is a collaboration with a distinctly British joy and charm, from Authentic Barbour Tartans to Paul Smith’s signature pops of colour and character. While a day out in the highlands may bring unexpected surprises, these are enduring styles full of the practicality – and personality – needed to match any moment.

entity.product_description_text:
[b]This edition of Threads features an exclusive cover design and sprayed edges available only at Paul Smith, perfect for collectors and fans alike.[/b] 

We invite you to dive into the world of Sir Paul Smith, with our special edition copy of Threads. Sir Paul’s journey has been anything but conventional: from leaving school at fifteen with a dream of being a professional racing cyclist to a life-altering accident that would change everything. After meeting the love of his life and immersing himself in the exciting new world of the 1960s London art and fashion scene, he would go on to build a global fashion empire that started off as a tiny shop tucked behind a dark, damp corridor in Nottingham. 

From a Nottingham alleyway to a global empire, this is the story of a truly unique British fashion icon. For the first time, and with his signature wit, Paul shares candid memories of a life in style, including what it was like to dress legends including David Bowie, Daniel Day-Lewis, Giorgio Armani and Sir Alex Ferguson; how he fought to keep his brand independent in a world of globalized homogeneity. Join him as he shares why, after five decades of success, you can still find him on the shopfloor every Saturday meeting his customers.

entity.meta_title_text: Artek Reimagined by Paul Smith - Aalto Four Colour-Stained Stool 60 - Edition Three
entity.product_description_text:
Artek reimagined by Paul Smith returns for its third edition with a new colourway of the iconic Stool 60. Since 2024, the two brands have collaborated on a series of reimagined design classics, united by a shared commitment to human-centric design, exceptional craftsmanship and innovation.

A long-time admirer of Aino and Alvar Aalto's work, Sir Paul Smith continues to reimagine their design classics through his own lens. Following the success of the first two editions, the third release builds on the playful use of wood stains and contrasting colours. As before, the stool's seat is finished in a natural wood stain that conceals a Malachite Green underside, revealed only when the stool is flipped over.

The legs are stained in Lemon Yellow, Burgundy and Melrose Pink—colours drawn from Paul Smith's Signature Stripe. Restocked on all three editions, the stools are designed to stack together, with their differently coloured legs creating an echo of Paul Smith’s iconic Signature Stripe.

Originally designed in 1933, the Stool 60 Remains an iconic piece of design and is suitable as a seat, table or decorative surface.

relatedColors.product_description_text:
Alvar Aalto's iconic Stool 60, reimagined by Paul Smith. 

Featuring four colours taken from our 'Signature Stripe' and applying them to the Stool 60's birch wood frame, the underneath of the stool is painted in an ultramarine blue - as a reference to the vibrant linings which appear within our suits.

Alvar Aalto's iconic Stool 60 is the most elemental of furniture pieces, equally suitable as a seat, a table, storage unit, or display surface. Born of modernist ideals and Finnish innovation, its great legacy and continued relevance owe much to Alvar Aalto's original vision for a universal object made entirely from native birch.

relatedColors.meta_title_text: Artek Reimagined by Paul Smith - Aalto Four Colour-Stained Stool 60 - Edition Two
relatedColors.product_description_text:
Following the success of the debut collaboration, Paul Smith is thrilled to announce a continuation of the partnership with the Finnish designers: Artek Reimagined by Paul Smith, Edition Two.

This time, the collaboration consists of a single piece: the Stool 60, which arrives in a brand-new set of colours. As before, the stool’s seat is stained in a natural wood tone, concealing a hidden flash of colour: flip it over and the underside of the seat, painted in a bold pillar box red, is revealed. This is a reference to the vibrant linings which often hide within the more understated exteriors of Paul Smith suits – a perfect example of the ‘twist’ that Sir Paul likes to incorporate into all of his designs. The legs, meanwhile, are painted in sky blue, rust, and British racing green respectively, colours plucked from among the forty shades that make up the Signature Stripe.

entity.product_description_text:
Following the success of the debut collaboration, Paul Smith is thrilled to announce a continuation of the partnership with the Finnish designers: Artek Reimagined by Paul Smith, Edition Two.

This time, the collaboration consists of a single piece: the Stool 60, which arrives in a brand-new set of colours. As before, the stool’s seat is stained in a natural wood tone, concealing a hidden flash of colour: flip it over and the underside of the seat, painted in a bold pillar box red, is revealed. This is a reference to the vibrant linings which often hide within the more understated exteriors of Paul Smith suits – a perfect example of the ‘twist’ that Sir Paul likes to incorporate into all of his designs. The legs, meanwhile, are painted in sky blue, rust, and British racing green respectively, colours plucked from among the forty shades that make up the Signature Stripe.

relatedColors.product_description_text:
Artek reimagined by Paul Smith returns for its third edition with a new colourway of the iconic Stool 60. Since 2024, the two brands have collaborated on a series of reimagined design classics, united by a shared commitment to human-centric design, exceptional craftsmanship and innovation.

A long-time admirer of Aino and Alvar Aalto's work, Sir Paul Smith continues to reimagine their design classics through his own lens. Following the success of the first two editions, the third release builds on the playful use of wood stains and contrasting colours. As before, the stool's seat is finished in a natural wood stain that conceals a Malachite Green underside, revealed only when the stool is flipped over.

The legs are stained in Lemon Yellow, Burgundy and Melrose Pink—colours drawn from Paul Smith's Signature Stripe. Restocked on all three editions, the stools are designed to stack together, with their differently coloured legs creating an echo of Paul Smith’s iconic Signature Stripe.

Originally designed in 1933, the Stool 60 Remains an iconic piece of design and is suitable as a seat, table or decorative surface.

body.title: A glimpse inside Paul’s world.
body.description: The walls of Paul Smith’s London studio are densely packed with art, objects and ephemera from Paul’s personal collection. Photographs of iconic musicians sit alongside archival design sketches, handwritten notes, paintings, curiosities and fragments of inspiration gathered over the years. This varied mix reflects Paul’s instinct for collecting the unexpected. At the centre of the print is a racing bike from the Paul Smith + Factor collaboration, bringing together engineering, design and Paul’s distinctive eye for detail. The print captures the eclectic spirit of Paul’s studio — a place where art, design, memories and unexpected discoveries come together.

For London Craft Week Paul Smith's Foundation launches an annual grant to celebrate British makers. 'British Makers - Glass' is a new initiative that gives a cash award to five British glassblowers to develop a new product in response to a creative brief, set by Sir Paul Smith - to reimagine the water jug. 

Glassblowers worked to specific briefs set out by the Paul Smith Home and Interiors team. These are: Humour, Pattern, Form, Stripe and Colour
entity.meta_description_text: In 2020, with a distinct aesthetic and refined skillset, Phoebe founded Gather. Gather is a modern British glassmaking studio in Woolwich, London.
entity.meta_title_text: Gather for Paul Smith's Foundation - Large Water Jug
entity.product_description_text:
Phoebe Stubbs discovered glass twenty years ago at an introductory workshop. The weight, heat, and tactility of the material left a lasting impression. She left interior design to train intensively, studied at the Rhode Island School of Design, and honed her craft alongside leading glassmakers through apprenticeships and assistant roles.

In 2020, with a distinct aesthetic and refined skillset, Phoebe founded Gather. Gather is a modern British glassmaking studio in Woolwich, London. We make handblown glassware, contemporary lighting and craft experiences, all shaped by hand in our London hotshop.

entity.product_description_text:
Alvar Aalto's iconic Stool 60, reimagined by Paul Smith. 

Featuring four colours taken from our 'Signature Stripe' and applying them to the Stool 60's birch wood frame, the underneath of the stool is painted in an ultramarine blue - as a reference to the vibrant linings which appear within our suits.

Alvar Aalto's iconic Stool 60 is the most elemental of furniture pieces, equally suitable as a seat, a table, storage unit, or display surface. Born of modernist ideals and Finnish innovation, its great legacy and continued relevance owe much to Alvar Aalto's original vision for a universal object made entirely from native birch.

relatedColors.meta_title_text: Artek Reimagined by Paul Smith - Aalto Four Colour-Stained Stool 60 - Edition Three
relatedColors.product_description_text:
Artek reimagined by Paul Smith returns for its third edition with a new colourway of the iconic Stool 60. Since 2024, the two brands have collaborated on a series of reimagined design classics, united by a shared commitment to human-centric design, exceptional craftsmanship and innovation.

A long-time admirer of Aino and Alvar Aalto's work, Sir Paul Smith continues to reimagine their design classics through his own lens. Following the success of the first two editions, the third release builds on the playful use of wood stains and contrasting colours. As before, the stool's seat is finished in a natural wood stain that conceals a Malachite Green underside, revealed only when the stool is flipped over.

The legs are stained in Lemon Yellow, Burgundy and Melrose Pink—colours drawn from Paul Smith's Signature Stripe. Restocked on all three editions, the stools are designed to stack together, with their differently coloured legs creating an echo of Paul Smith’s iconic Signature Stripe.

Originally designed in 1933, the Stool 60 Remains an iconic piece of design and is suitable as a seat, table or decorative surface.

relatedColors.meta_title_text: Artek Reimagined by Paul Smith - Aalto Four Colour-Stained Stool 60 - Edition Two
relatedColors.product_description_text:
Following the success of the debut collaboration, Paul Smith is thrilled to announce a continuation of the partnership with the Finnish designers: Artek Reimagined by Paul Smith, Edition Two.

This time, the collaboration consists of a single piece: the Stool 60, which arrives in a brand-new set of colours. As before, the stool’s seat is stained in a natural wood tone, concealing a hidden flash of colour: flip it over and the underside of the seat, painted in a bold pillar box red, is revealed. This is a reference to the vibrant linings which often hide within the more understated exteriors of Paul Smith suits – a perfect example of the ‘twist’ that Sir Paul likes to incorporate into all of his designs. The legs, meanwhile, are painted in sky blue, rust, and British racing green respectively, colours plucked from among the forty shades that make up the Signature Stripe.

Bring a touch of France to your garden or beach day with Jaques of London’s 8 Boule Set – the ultimate outdoor game of skill, strategy, and precision! Known as Boules or Petanque, this traditional European game is perfect for relaxed yet competitive play between friends or family. The goal is simple: throw your polished metal boules and get them as close as possible to the small wooden jack (or ''butt'') – it’s a game of finesse, focus, and a whole lot of fun!

Beautifully presented in a zipped canvas carry case, this premium set includes eight polished alloy boules designed for long-lasting play. Whether you're on the lawn, beach, or village green, this set brings people together for a timeless, sociable game steeped in tradition.

entity.product_description_text:
Paul Smith has returned to collaborate with The Rug Company on a collection of seven new rugs, the designs experiment with familiar forms to create abstract motifs that inform the shape of the rugs. This collection encapsulates the evolution of a historic creative partnership while offering a new perspective on the relationship between color and shape.

Spectra offers a sophisticated and subtle alternative to the colorful characteristic of the original stripe design. Rectangular blocks of color use a spectrum of shades that are synonymous with the Paul Smith brand and shift across the surface in a regimented form. 

Each color is handknotted in a lustrous silk thread that appears elevated against the rich density of the neutral wool base. This design complements transitional spaces, encouraging movement whilst enhancing surroundings with its contemporary take on colorful design.

relatedColors.product_description_text:
Bring a touch of France to your garden or beach day with Jaques of London’s 8 Boule Set – the ultimate outdoor game of skill, strategy, and precision! Known as Boules or Petanque, this traditional European game is perfect for relaxed yet competitive play between friends or family. The goal is simple: throw your polished metal boules and get them as close as possible to the small wooden jack (or ''butt'') – it’s a game of finesse, focus, and a whole lot of fun!

Beautifully presented in a zipped canvas carry case, this premium set includes eight polished alloy boules designed for long-lasting play. Whether you're on the lawn, beach, or village green, this set brings people together for a timeless, sociable game steeped in tradition.

entity.meta_title_text: Ratio by Paul Smith x The Rug Company - Stil Olive Rug
entity.product_description_text:
In the latest chapter of their enduring creative partnership, The Rug Company unveils Ratio by Paul Smith, a collection that translates the designer’s distinctive approach to pattern into richly tactile form. A longstanding admirer of modernist design, Paul Smith brings his characteristic balance of discipline and expressiveness to the collection, with The Rug Company's artisanal expertise adding a helping hand. 

Ratio comprises of four designs—Axis, Stil, Raster and Takt—all in different formats, each offering a distinct interpretation of geometric order. 

[b]Stil Olive[/b] balances retro geometry with the softness of New Zealand wool. Designed with a retro sensibility, it utilises Moroccan shag and Tulu techniques to build depth through layered texture. Tonal variation gives the surface nostalgic richness and character, while blocks of earthy colour ground the geometry in livable warmth.

[b]Size shown in imagery does not always represent the size available to buy online. If you require a larger size, please contact customer services directly.[/b]

relatedColors.meta_title_text: Ratio by Paul Smith x The Rug Company - Raster Aegean Rug
relatedColors.product_description_text:
In the latest chapter of their enduring creative partnership, The Rug Company unveils Ratio by Paul Smith, a collection that translates the designer’s distinctive approach to pattern into richly tactile form. A longstanding admirer of modernist design, Paul Smith brings his characteristic balance of discipline and expressiveness to the collection, with The Rug Company's artisanal expertise adding a helping hand. 

Ratio comprises of four designs—Axis, Stil, Raster and Takt—all in different formats, each offering a distinct interpretation of geometric order. 

[b]Raster Aegean[/b] softens its graphic design through texture. Bold blocks and stripes in tonal blue hues sit against a richly tactile ground, creating a quiet interplay between pattern and surface. Handknotted in New Zealand wool using the Tulu technique, rows of cut pile and flatweave bring depth and movement to the Bauhaus-inspired design.

relatedColors.product_description_text:
Bring a touch of France to your garden or beach day with Jaques of London’s 8 Boule Set – the ultimate outdoor game of skill, strategy, and precision! Known as Boules or Petanque, this traditional European game is perfect for relaxed yet competitive play between friends or family. The goal is simple: throw your polished metal boules and get them as close as possible to the small wooden jack (or ''butt'') – it’s a game of finesse, focus, and a whole lot of fun!

Beautifully presented in a zipped canvas carry case, this premium set includes eight polished alloy boules designed for long-lasting play. Whether you're on the lawn, beach, or village green, this set brings people together for a timeless, sociable game steeped in tradition.

entity.name: Paul Smith + Wallace Sewell - Multicolour Check Merino-Lambswool Throw
entity.product_description_text:
Designed in collaboration with Wallace Sewell, this luxurious throw is made in the British Isles from 100% Merino lambswool from Australia and South Africa then spun in Yorkshire, UK. 

Featuring two contrasting check pattern sides that are created entirely through the structure of the weave itself, the daytime stripe features bright, vivid and bold colours that capture the energy of the Paul Smith palette, while the reverse side, the night time stripe is rendered in much more muted tones offering a calmer, more understated look.

Wallace and Newell use solely natural fibres in their scarves, throws and cushions. These are a renewable resource and do not release microplastics into the environment.

The perfect addition to your home, this throw is also featured in the Paul Smith suite at Brown's Hotel.

entity.meta_title_text: Artek Reimagined by Paul Smith - Aalto Five Colour-Stained Screen 100
entity.product_description_text:
Alvar Aalto's Screen 100, reimagined by Paul Smith.

The solid pine slats are individually stained using two of Artek's house finishes, and three custom ones made for Paul Smith. When combined, they create a muted version of our timeless 'Signature Stripe'.

Made of fine pinewood strips that have been vertically aligned, Screen 100 can be rolled up for storage and rolled out to form straight lines or fluid curves. The screen can be used to divide rooms or section off areas, and at 150 cm tall, it will add structure to a space without obscuring vision. Light, with balanced proportions, the screen is easy to move around as needed, and will bring the warmth of wood to any room in which it’s placed. Designed by Alvar Aalto, Screen 100 displays the Finnish master’s unmatched ability to meld traditional materials with organic shapes.
entity.short_description_text: Alvar Aalto's Screen 100, reimagined by Paul Smith.

relatedColors.product_description_text:
Alvar Aalto's iconic Stool 60, reimagined by Paul Smith. 

Featuring four colours taken from our 'Signature Stripe' and applying them to the Stool 60's birch wood frame, the underneath of the stool is painted in an ultramarine blue - as a reference to the vibrant linings which appear within our suits.

Alvar Aalto's iconic Stool 60 is the most elemental of furniture pieces, equally suitable as a seat, a table, storage unit, or display surface. Born of modernist ideals and Finnish innovation, its great legacy and continued relevance owe much to Alvar Aalto's original vision for a universal object made entirely from native birch.

relatedColors.meta_title_text: Artek Reimagined by Paul Smith - Aalto Four Colour-Stained Stool 60 - Edition Two
relatedColors.product_description_text:
Following the success of the debut collaboration, Paul Smith is thrilled to announce a continuation of the partnership with the Finnish designers: Artek Reimagined by Paul Smith, Edition Two.

This time, the collaboration consists of a single piece: the Stool 60, which arrives in a brand-new set of colours. As before, the stool’s seat is stained in a natural wood tone, concealing a hidden flash of colour: flip it over and the underside of the seat, painted in a bold pillar box red, is revealed. This is a reference to the vibrant linings which often hide within the more understated exteriors of Paul Smith suits – a perfect example of the ‘twist’ that Sir Paul likes to incorporate into all of his designs. The legs, meanwhile, are painted in sky blue, rust, and British racing green respectively, colours plucked from among the forty shades that make up the Signature Stripe.

relatedOutfitting.product_description_text: Paul Smith + Grenson have teamed up to offer a capsule of timeless classic footwear with each pair being made in Northampton by Grenson, in their original factory that has been in operation since 1866. Finished with rubber and leather soles for added grip, punctuated with pops of blue, a signature of Paul Smith design.

entity.name: Stewart Hearn for Paul Smith Foundation - Amber Owl Water Jug
entity.care_info_text: Please note: All pieces have been hand made, therefore please expect each piece to be slightly unique from the original photos online.
entity.features_information_text:
Size: 20cm High x 15cm wing tip to wing tip

For London Craft Week Paul Smith's Foundation launches an annual grant to celebrate British makers. 'British Makers - Glass' is a new initiative that gives a cash award to five British glassblowers to develop a new product in response to a creative brief, set by Sir Paul Smith - to reimagine the water jug. 

Glassblowers worked to specific briefs set out by the Paul Smith Home and Interiors team. These are: Humour, Pattern, Form, Stripe and Colour
entity.meta_description_text: Stewart Hearn is a master glassmaker, graduating from Sunderland Polytechnic in 1986. He has taken London Glassworks from strength to strength since its inception in 2002.
entity.meta_title_text: Stewart Hearn for Paul Smith Foundation - Amber Owl Water Jug
entity.product_description_text:
Stewart Hearn is a master glassmaker, graduating from Sunderland Polytechnic in 1986. He has taken London Glassworks from strength to strength since its inception in 2002. 

Stewart's designs have a studied balance of form, colour translucency and weight that show tacit knowledge, command and someone at ease with an ancient craft.

As a recognised and accomplished glass artist Stewart is able to focus on limited edition and unique pieces which is what he enjoys making the most. In addition to this work, he produces glass for a range of clients and in various capacities.

Familiar pieces, colours and patterns are revisited and reimagined through a contemporary lens, bringing new depth to tailoring and considered contrasts of colour, texture and proportion. First unveiled in Milan in January, the collection marks a new chapter for Paul Smith — where the familiar takes on a new perspective.

relatedColors.care_info_text:
Made in Italy

Weight: 230g (Size M)

[b]Kask[/b]

KASK, based in Italy, specializes in developing, designing, and manufacturing of safety helmets of the highest quality. In every field of application KASK helmets are at the forefront, be it cycling, downhill skiing, mountaineering or rescue work.

Created in 2004, KASK employs a talented team of expert engineers and has partnerships with Italy's market-leading factories which has lead to awards from ISPO and Eurobike.

KASK's mission is to maintain a perfect balance between technological excellence, functionality, safety, and attractive design in their products. Now among the top brands in sports, KASK is committed to maintaining the highest standards in safety helmet production in order to ensure the highest quality and offer the best protective helmets for the most demanding customers.
