entity.product_description_text:
Kit Kat Club by David Remfry (1999)

[b]David Remfry[/b]

Born in Worthing in 1942, David Remfry studied at Hull College of Art (1959-64) before establishing himself as a full- time artist in London. Renowned for his large-scale watercolours of dancers and urban life, he captures the energy of nightlife- from Hull's Locarno dancehall in his student years to New York City clubs during his long residency at the Hotel Chelsea from 1995 to 2016. Where the Light Falls brings together key strands of Remfry's work, including his watercolours of dancers alongaide more recent oil paintings.

Remfry' was elected to the Royal Academy of Arts in 2006 where he served as Professor of Drawing at the RA Schools from 2016-18, and in 2023, he coordinated the Royal Academy's Summer Exhibition.

This exhibition coincides with the release of a Monograph David Remfry published by Lund Humphries with essays by Chloe Aridjis, Hettie Judah, Rosalind McKever, Gerardine Mulcahy-Parker and Kathleen Soriano.

The exhibition has been curated by art historian and writer, Jo Baring.

entity.name: Jochen Holz for Paul Smith's Foundation - Clear Blue Water Jug
entity.features_information_text:
For London Craft Week Paul Smith's Foundation launches an annual grant to celebrate British makers. 'British Makers - Glass' is a new initiative that gives a cash award to five British glassblowers to develop a new product in response to a creative brief, set by Sir Paul Smith - to reimagine the water jug. 

Glassblowers worked to specific briefs set out by the Paul Smith Home and Interiors team. These are: Humour, Pattern, Form, Stripe and Colour
entity.meta_description_text: Jochen Holz is a London-based master glass maker. Specialised in lampworking, Holz transforms high quality glass tubes into one-off glassware, bespoke objects, jewellery, and neon light sculptures.
entity.meta_title_text: Jochen Holz for Paul Smith's Foundation - Clear Blue Water Jug
entity.product_description_text: Jochen Holz is a London-based master glass maker. Specialised in lampworking, Holz transforms high quality glass tubes into one-off glassware, bespoke objects, jewellery, and neon light sculptures. By letting the process and materiality of molten glass play a central role in his practice, a high level of spontaneous decisions and intuition are present in his design.

body.title: The Soho - Slim-Fit
body.description: The Soho is a classic for a reason. Our bestselling suit, it combines a clean, slim silhouette with a relaxed, natural feel. The half-canvas construction gives the jacket just the right amount of structure, while the slim lapel and slim-leg trousers keep things refined and modern. Smart enough for the big occasions, easy enough for everything in between, the Soho is made to move with you — wherever the day (or night) takes you.

250ml e 8.4 fl oz

Fragrance notes: Rain, Iris, Suede, Patchouli 

To get the best from your diffuser, there’s a few tips and tricks to keep in mind. Carefully open the bottle containing the liquid and slowly pour its entire contents into the glass vessel. Next, place the collar on top and insert the reeds. You might find that it takes up to 24 hours for the reeds to fully absorb the fragrance. For best scent diffusion, place in a room with good air circulation and try turning the reeds every now and then. Speaking of which, be mindful not to place your diffuser near the edges of surfaces (and keep it away from wagging tails and little ones). When it’s time to reuse the vessel, avoid using the dishwasher. Instead, wash in warm soapy water.

Paul Smith has partnered with the legendary British comic Beano, to create a limited-edition capsule collection celebrating Sir Paul Smith’s lifelong love for the comic. 

Taking inspiration from the comic itself, this T-shirt features a 'Comic Strip' print on the front - adopting Beano’s distinct artistic style, combined with Paul Smith’s design classics.

Made from 100% cotton for soft everyday comfort, this T-shirt is cut in a regular-fit and is finished with a dual-branded label stitched at the hem.

body.title: Complimentary copy of Rebel Revolution - a special edition Beano comic, with every purchase
body.description: Inspired by Dennis the Menace being one of the original punks, the eight-piece collection brings together Beano’s unmistakable artwork with our own playful design details. To mark the launch, every Paul Smith + Beano purchase comes with a complimentary copy of Paul Smith’s Rebel Revolution — a special-edition Beano comic in which Paul steps into the pages of Bash Street School alongside Dennis the Menace and friends, bringing a dose of colour and individuality to the story.

entity.meta_title_text: Harrows for Paul Smith - Dartboard
entity.product_description_text:
Harrows tournament-grade engineering meets Paul Smith's design heritage in one collaboration, a partnership where technical precision and iconic British design speak the same language.

Made from the finest Madagascan sisal fibres for a dense, resilient playing surface with genuine self-healing properties, extending the board's life.

Ultra-fine, hardened knife-wiring keeps the profile clean and high-end while maximising usable target area, fewer bounce-outs and a board that looks as good as it plays.

Includes a built-in levelling system for precise, stable wall mounting, allowing the board to go up straight first time on any wall surface, no spirit level required.

entity.features_information_text:
- Dart length: 51mm

-  90% tungsten is the standard of professional darts. This dart offers a slim profile barrel that enables tighter grouping. It isn't just beautifully designed; it’s built to perform at the highest level of the game.
entity.meta_description_text: The Harrows for Paul Smith darts set features three sets of durable, high-performance shafts finished with meticulously machined rings that lock flights securely in place, tournament-grade reliability with the collaboration's design aesthetic built in.
entity.meta_title_text: Harrows for Paul Smith - Darts Set
entity.product_description_text:
Harrows tournament-grade darts engineering meets Paul Smith's design heritage in one collaboration, a partnership where technical precision and iconic British design speak the same language.

The Harrows for Paul Smith barrels are CNC-Milled, a technique which allows more unique and complex shapes and cuts to be machined into the barrel as opposed to the standard radial groove machining process.

The Harrows for Paul Smith darts set features three sets of durable, high-performance shafts finished with meticulously machined rings that lock flights securely in place, tournament-grade reliability with the collaboration's design aesthetic built in.

Complete with three sets of 100-micron flights, the widely favoured standard for performance and durability, finished with UV printing and a protective laminate, carrying the iconic Paul Smith Stripe across all 3 sets.

Complete with the Harrows Quick Point System which allows players to screw in and out points in seconds using the point tool included in the set which also doubles up as a storage for points.

products.meta_title_text: Harrows for Paul Smith - Dartboard
products.product_description_text:
Harrows tournament-grade engineering meets Paul Smith's design heritage in one collaboration, a partnership where technical precision and iconic British design speak the same language.

Made from the finest Madagascan sisal fibres for a dense, resilient playing surface with genuine self-healing properties, extending the board's life.

Ultra-fine, hardened knife-wiring keeps the profile clean and high-end while maximising usable target area, fewer bounce-outs and a board that looks as good as it plays.

Includes a built-in levelling system for precise, stable wall mounting, allowing the board to go up straight first time on any wall surface, no spirit level required.

products.meta_title_text: Harrows for Paul Smith - Darts Set
products.product_description_text:
Harrows tournament-grade darts engineering meets Paul Smith's design heritage in one collaboration, a partnership where technical precision and iconic British design speak the same language.

The Harrows for Paul Smith barrels are CNC-Milled, a technique which allows more unique and complex shapes and cuts to be machined into the barrel as opposed to the standard radial groove machining process.

The Harrows for Paul Smith darts set features three sets of durable, high-performance shafts finished with meticulously machined rings that lock flights securely in place, tournament-grade reliability with the collaboration's design aesthetic built in.

Complete with three sets of 100-micron flights, the widely favoured standard for performance and durability, finished with UV printing and a protective laminate, carrying the iconic Paul Smith Stripe across all 3 sets.

Complete with the Harrows Quick Point System which allows players to screw in and out points in seconds using the point tool included in the set which also doubles up as a storage for points.

The wax is housed in a tinted glass vessel complete with a contrasting lid that doubles as a coaster, an expression of Paul’s fondness for colour and its endless combinations. Fragrance notes: Lemon, Black Pepper, Vetiver, Moss.

entity.product_description_text:
Milonga by David Remfry (2012-2018)

[b]David Remfry[/b]

Born in Worthing in 1942, David Remfry studied at Hull College of Art (1959-64) before establishing himself as a full- time artist in London. Renowned for his large-scale watercolours of dancers and urban life, he captures the energy of nightlife- from Hull's Locarno dancehall in his student years to New York City clubs during his long residency at the Hotel Chelsea from 1995 to 2016. Where the Light Falls brings together key strands of Remfry's work, including his watercolours of dancers alongaide more recent oil paintings.

Remfry' was elected to the Royal Academy of Arts in 2006 where he served as Professor of Drawing at the RA Schools from 2016-18, and in 2023, he coordinated the Royal Academy's Summer Exhibition.

This exhibition coincides with the release of a Monograph David Remfry published by Lund Humphries with essays by Chloe Aridjis, Hettie Judah, Rosalind McKever, Gerardine Mulcahy-Parker and Kathleen Soriano.

The exhibition has been curated by art historian and writer, Jo Baring.

entity.features_information_text:

- Push button with integrated eraser and chamber containing spare Ø 0.5 mm leads, accessible by removing the push button
- Collectable, durable and reusable metal boxes
- Case Dimensions: 185 x 55 x 20 mm
- Weight: 84g (74g without product)
entity.meta_description_text: For over ten years, Caran d’Ache and Paul Smith have celebrated their shared passion for colour, design and audacity. With this 5th edition, the Swiss Maison and the British designer playfully push boundaries to reinvent the art of the beautifully crafted object.
entity.meta_title_text: Caran d'Ache + Paul Smith - 849 Silver 'Signature Stripe' Mechanical Pencil
entity.product_description_text:
For over ten years, Caran d’Ache and Paul Smith have celebrated their shared passion for colour, design and audacity. With this 5th edition, the Swiss Maison and the British designer playfully push boundaries to reinvent the art of the beautifully crafted object.

Made in Switzerland with a lightweight and durable hexagonal aluminium body, this pen features a raw silver effect body, stamped with 8 colour signature stripes.

Presented in a raw silver effect metal case with a black Caran d’Ache + Paul Smith logo on the outside, this pencil comes with one Ø 0.5 mm HB graphite lead.

Made in England with materials of known provenance, every piece is hand-inspected and made to the highest standard.

entity.name: Paul Smith + The Lab Co. - Footwear Care Kit
entity.excerpt:
The Lab Co. has partnered with Liquiproof LABS to bring you the world's best shoe cleaning kit. Including everything you need to protect, clean and care for your shoes, jackets, bags and other fashion items. This limited edition in collaboration with Paul Smith features special design packaging and labeling throughout.

Keep your items protected from rain, stains and spills with the world-leading water-proofing spray Liquiproof™ premium protector.

Use Lab Co.'s eco-friendly and highly performative shoe cleaning spray to prevent stains and remove soiling from all types of fabric and textiles. Instantly remove bad odour and eliminate any lingering bacteria with our fast-acting fabric freshener spray suitable to use on all types of fabrics and textiles.

Easy, modern and made for wearing your way.

body.title: Meet Douglas — a curious wooden creature with his head in the clouds.
body.description: Created by east London design studio Studiomama, he’s part of their playful Off-Cuts collection, a cast of characterful wooden creatures made from scrap wood left behind in their workshop. Douglas is, naturally, the resident daydreamer. Made by layering, dyeing and shaping wood, Douglas celebrates the beauty of handmade craft and the character of leftover materials. A passionate collector with a love of handmade objects, Paul Smith took a particular shine to the Off-Cuts and their playful, inventive spirit. Now, Douglas makes the leap from wooden workshop character to graphic motif, appearing on this T-shirt in the new capsule collection.

body.title: Paul Smith loves Barbour: The Story
body.subtitle: Behind the Collection
body.description: Rooted in Barbour’s Scottish heritage and Paul Smith’s playful spirit, this is a collaboration with a distinctly British joy and charm, from Authentic Barbour Tartans to Paul Smith’s signature pops of colour and character. While a day out in the highlands may bring unexpected surprises, these are enduring styles full of the practicality – and personality – needed to match any moment.

For London Craft Week Paul Smith's Foundation launches an annual grant to celebrate British makers. 'British Makers - Glass' is a new initiative that gives a cash award to five British glassblowers to develop a new product in response to a creative brief, set by Sir Paul Smith - to reimagine the water jug.

entity.meta_description_text: The Rug Company unveils Ratio by Paul Smith, the Takt Natural rug explores the precision of geometry through tactile form.
entity.meta_title_text: Ratio by Paul Smith x The Rug Company - Takt Natural Rug
entity.product_description_text:
In the latest chapter of their enduring creative partnership, The Rug Company unveils Ratio by Paul Smith, a collection that translates the designer’s distinctive approach to pattern into richly tactile form. A longstanding admirer of modernist design, Paul Smith brings his characteristic balance of discipline and expressiveness to the collection, with The Rug Company's artisanal expertise adding a helping hand. 

Ratio comprises of four designs—Axis, Stil, Raster and Takt—all in different formats, each offering a distinct interpretation of geometric order. 

[b]Takt Natural[/b] is guided by the Bauhaus ideas of proportion and geometry, bringing pattern into a more tactile, dimensional space. Blocks of varied natural tones and shifting textures create a dimensional surface, while undyed New Zealand wool adds depth and a gentle vintage feel to the palette. 

Newly, Takt highlights two construction techniques: Tulu and Indo-Nepali handknot. This technical innovation, executed in collaboration with our artisans, delivers a sculptural rug that changes character as you experience it: graphic from afar and richly textured up close.

[b]Size shown in imagery does not always represent the size available to buy online. If you require a larger size, please contact customer services directly.[/b]

entity.product_description_text:
In the latest chapter of their enduring creative partnership, The Rug Company unveils Ratio by Paul Smith, a collection that translates the designer’s distinctive approach to pattern into richly tactile form. A longstanding admirer of modernist design, Paul Smith brings his characteristic balance of discipline and expressiveness to the collection, with The Rug Company's artisanal expertise adding a helping hand. 

[b]Takt Indigo[/b] is guided by the Bauhaus ideas of proportion and geometry, bringing pattern into a more tactile, dimensional space. Blocks of varied cool tones and shifting textures create a dimensional surface, while New Zealand wool adds depth and a gentle vintage feel to the palette. 

Newly, Takt highlights two construction techniques: Tulu and Indo-Nepali handknot. This technical innovation, executed in collaboration with our artisans, delivers a sculptural rug that changes character as you experience it: graphic from afar and richly textured up close.

[b]Size shown in imagery does not always represent the size available to buy online. If you require a larger size, please contact customer services directly.[/b]

In the latest chapter of their enduring creative partnership, The Rug Company unveils Ratio by Paul Smith, a collection that translates the designer’s distinctive approach to pattern into richly tactile form. A longstanding admirer of modernist design, Paul Smith brings his characteristic balance of discipline and expressiveness to the collection, with The Rug Company's artisanal expertise adding a helping hand. 

Ratio comprises of four designs—Axis, Stil, Raster and Takt—all in different formats, each offering a distinct interpretation of geometric order.

relatedColors.product_description_text:
In the latest chapter of their enduring creative partnership, The Rug Company unveils Ratio by Paul Smith, a collection that translates the designer’s distinctive approach to pattern into richly tactile form. A longstanding admirer of modernist design, Paul Smith brings his characteristic balance of discipline and expressiveness to the collection, with The Rug Company's artisanal expertise adding a helping hand. 

Ratio comprises of four designs—Axis, Stil, Raster and Takt—all in different formats, each offering a distinct interpretation of geometric order. 

[b]Takt Natural[/b] is guided by the Bauhaus ideas of proportion and geometry, bringing pattern into a more tactile, dimensional space. Blocks of varied natural tones and shifting textures create a dimensional surface, while undyed New Zealand wool adds depth and a gentle vintage feel to the palette. 

Newly, Takt highlights two construction techniques: Tulu and Indo-Nepali handknot. This technical innovation, executed in collaboration with our artisans, delivers a sculptural rug that changes character as you experience it: graphic from afar and richly textured up close.

relatedOutfitting.material_information_text: 100% Leather Uppers, Leather and Rubber soles
relatedOutfitting.meta_description_text: Paul Smith + Grenson have teamed up to offer a capsule of timeless classic footwear.
relatedOutfitting.product_description_text: Paul Smith + Grenson have teamed up to offer a capsule of timeless classic footwear with each pair being made in Northampton by Grenson, in their original factory that has been in operation since 1866. The 'Coleman' is a straight-cap Derby boot made from naturally grained black French bison leather, with a soft black Nappa bellows tongue and natural calf lining, featuring Grenson's Triple Welt construction: a unique stepped, triple style welt that makes the most of classic British Goodyear welted shoemaking. Finished with rubber and leather soles for added grip, punctuated with pops of blue, a signature of Paul Smith design.

products.meta_title_text: Stone Cotton Herringbone Field Jacket
products.product_description_text:
This field jacket takes a military-inspired shape and gives it a modern upgrade. Crafted from BCI cotton herringbone woven at Halley Stevensons' Baltic Works in Dundee, it's cut and sewn in London by White Label and lined in deadstock fabric. One of the standout pieces from our Made in the British Isles collection, it works just as well over a shirt in the city as it does layered up with a chunky knit for the weekend. Cut for an oversized fit with some shaping through the back, the front body is cut straight to give more room in the chest.

Available online only, with quantities replenished gradually owing to its handcrafted construction. Click on your selected size to be notified when it is back in stock.

gift_budget_quiz: I'm splurging
entity.features_information_text:
Made in Nottingham, England

This collection features designs which are inspired by vintage handmade tapestries. The outer face of the silk has been meticulously screen printed with the front side of the tapestry, while the inner face is printed with the tapestry's reverse as a playful hidden detail. The collection has been made in the UK and is exclusively made for Paul Smith.

[b]Daniel Hanson[/b]

[i]Daniel Hanson is a unique design and manufacture brand.

Established by Daniel and Julie Hanson in 1989, and with a reputation worldwide as the go-to dressing gown makers for Jermyn Street, Savile Row, and luxury institutions worldwide, they have been producing world-class garments from the start.

The brand itself is still a well-kept secret; worn in private by royalty and celebrity the world over. Their products not only look spectacular but feel distinctly luxurious to wear.

The product range today is indicative of Daniel Hanson’s status as a small and impeccable specialist manufacture house.[/i]

entity.meta_title_text: Ratio by Paul Smith x The Rug Company - Takt Ash Rug
entity.product_description_text:
In the latest chapter of their enduring creative partnership, The Rug Company unveils Ratio by Paul Smith, a collection that translates the designer’s distinctive approach to pattern into richly tactile form. A longstanding admirer of modernist design, Paul Smith brings his characteristic balance of discipline and expressiveness to the collection, with The Rug Company's artisanal expertise adding a helping hand. 

Ratio comprises of four designs—Axis, Stil, Raster and Takt—all in different formats, each offering a distinct interpretation of geometric order. 

[b]Takt Ash[/b] is guided by the Bauhaus ideas of proportion and geometry, bringing pattern into a more tactile, dimensional space. Blocks of varied grey tones and shifting textures create a dimensional surface, while New Zealand wool adds depth and a gentle vintage feel to the palette. 

Newly, Takt highlights two construction techniques: Tulu and Indo-Nepali handknot. This technical innovation, executed in collaboration with our artisans, delivers a sculptural rug that changes character as you experience it: graphic from afar and richly textured up close.

[b]Size shown in imagery does not always represent the size available to buy online. If you require a larger size, please contact customer services directly.[/b]

In the latest chapter of their enduring creative partnership, The Rug Company unveils Ratio by Paul Smith, a collection that translates the designer’s distinctive approach to pattern into richly tactile form. A longstanding admirer of modernist design, Paul Smith brings his characteristic balance of discipline and expressiveness to the collection, with The Rug Company's artisanal expertise adding a helping hand. 

Ratio comprises of four designs—Axis, Stil, Raster and Takt—all in different formats, each offering a distinct interpretation of geometric order. 

[b]Raster Brick[/b] softens its graphic design through texture. Bold blocks and stripes in undyed neutral and rich tones sit against a richly tactile ground, creating a quiet interplay between pattern and surface. Handknotted in New Zealand wool using the Tulu technique, rows of cut pile and flatweave bring depth and movement to the Bauhaus-inspired design.

[b]Size shown in imagery does not always represent the size available to buy online. If you require a larger size, please contact customer services directly.[/b]
